<thought>To obtain the required template, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a transformation that breaks an amine and forms an amide (the forward reaction corresponds to amide formation from an amine and an acyl halide/acid derivative). This should retrieve the appropriate template ID. Then I can retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES for that template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Nc1ccccc1C(=O)Cl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["amine"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
